issue_context.title: `EntityMut::remove()` needs better docs to explain behavior
issue_context.body: It was recently mentioned in the discord that `EntityMut::remove()` has no docs, in particular whether it panics or not if the component the user attempted to remove is not present.

review_comments: I know this is technically correct, now that components are bundles, but it feels a bit less obvious that this can also be used to remove components
I considered specifying that it could be used with components, but none of the docs on `EntityCommands`' methods mentioned components other than the deprecated ones.
